description:
Evaluate whether the process for merging PRs that touch soundness paths is proportionate to the risk it controls, and whether it works for agent-assisted delivery.

Today a PR touching any path in .github/soundness-paths.txt (or matched by _project/scripts/auto_merge_soundness_paths.py) needs three things: a `Soundness review:` section in the PR body naming an external reviewer, linking the review comment, and stating all Critical/High findings are resolved; exclusion from auto-merge; and a manual enqueue by the maintainer. `make pr-ready` and `make pr-arm-auto-merge` refuse these PRs, and agent sessions are denied a direct `gh pr merge --auto` as a merge without review.

Observed effect: in a backlog of 14 open non-draft develop PRs, 12 touched soundness paths. The surface reaches beyond equivalence and expected-results code: .github/workflows/ci.yml, publication/ledger-seed.json, scripts/publication/verify_lane_isolation.py, the explorer pipeline under _project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/, scripts/generate_corpus_inventory.py, and comment-only edits to an equivalence builder. Green PRs with an external review link therefore waited on one human enqueue each, and one PR (comment-only change to benchbox/core/equivalence/builders/datavault.py) failed soundness-flag purely for lack of the review section.

Questions to answer:
- Is the path set too broad? Which entries guard comparator or oracle correctness, and which only reflect that the file is sensitive (CI wiring, data seeds, publication tooling)? Should purely generated-data, comment-only, or docs-only changes be classified differently?
- Is the review requirement checkable as written? soundness-flag verifies the section's presence and shape, not that a real review exists or covers the final head. Decide whether it should bind the review to the head SHA or reviewer identity.
- Is a single human enqueue per PR the right control once review evidence is present, or can a narrower, auditable enqueue path exist (for example an attested, head-pinned enqueue after the soundness gate passes) without weakening the gate?
- Should an agent be able to prepare soundness PRs to the point of enqueue and hand off a ready list, and is that handoff documented?
- Is the queue and drain reporting (soundness drain digest, green-unmerged sweep) enough to keep reviewed PRs from stalling?

Output: a short written recommendation per question, and either follow-up items for approved changes or a decision to keep the ceremony as is, with the reason.
